subject.title: A completed write disappears from the next read

capsule.title: A completed write disappears from the next read
capsule.summary: A register write completes before a later read begins, yet the read returns the initial value. No legal sequential history can preserve that real-time order.
capsule.trigger: Submit a two-operation history containing a completed write of 'new' followed by a non-overlapping read of null.
capsule.observed: The P-compositional search exhausts the legal register states and returns non-linearizable with an empty witness.
capsule.invariant: If operation A completes before operation B begins, every legal linearization places A before B and the read observes A's value.
capsule.fix: Reject the history and expose the failed component instead of manufacturing a sequential witness.

timeline.title: Complete the write
timeline.detail: Write operation 1 finishes at logical time 2 with value 'new'.

timeline.title: Return the initial value
timeline.detail: Read operation 2 begins at time 3 and reports null despite the completed write.

timeline.title: Exhaust legal orders
timeline.detail: Real-time precedence leaves no sequential register state matching the response.

timeline.title: Refuse a false witness
timeline.detail: The checker returns linearizable=false and an empty witness vector.

limits: The checker composes independent register histories; multi-object transactional linearizability is not claimed.
